title: Qabli weeqaytuk gandite rooci
intro: Kaxxa zulmih dabaanal, qanxaffe le num ardi absolute cruelty luk xiinisak suge waqdi, inki rooci amoytiini raacat lih imaan gita doorite. ta muuci caylih sorkocobaxih addat yan uxih numma geeh rammitle nabiyyih farmol. ken safar wakti sinni baritto akkele sabriiy, fida kee angoyya sinni kibal. atu baxxaaqissam duuddaa assakat le cankah miyyay qibaadah rufto baad caddok muxxi doorita?
clues: Anu kaxxa caylale daalatal mannoowak suge, uxih yi sorkocô baxi rammitle farmol numma geeh.
Anu yoo boode waam aaxaguk, Muusa miracsenta kataatam doorite.
Anu yi waktil kaxxa caylale qanxaffe luk digibeh suge, uxih kay dirab rabbitte cineh.
Yi gandi kaxxam gibduk suge, Anu inki Yallal aamineemih digaalime wak.
Anu inni amaanat qigdu maqammaxxaaga, walaa gibdi gandi yoo yoofe wak.
Yi degelti yi sabrit ruffa iyyeeh, gannatal kunnabnale arac yoo doore.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Yallih gital kalali qande luk qeebi abaanama.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
